product.title: Guided Night Kayak Adventure Tour in Luminous Lagoon

description.text: See the Key West lagoons in a whole new way. Go on a nocturnal adventure with clear kayaks and LED lights that illuminate the surroundings so you can see underwater. A local guide takes you and a small group to the best spots for a unique and memorable marine life experience lasting about 90 minutes.Experience a memorable nighttime adventure Embark on clear kayaks with LED illumination for a unique adventure Spot wildlife and nature that’s otherwise hard to see Enjoy a more personal experience with a local tour guide Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
